name: bcis-subscription-billing-system
description: BCIS Subscription Billing and Collection System

scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace=@bcis/shared && concurrently -k -n API,DESKTOP -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace=@bcis/api" "npm run dev --workspace=@bcis/desktop"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build --workspace=@bcis/shared && npm run dev --workspace=@bcis/api
scripts.dev:desktop: npm run build --workspace=@bcis/shared && npm run dev --workspace=@bcis/desktop
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@bcis/shared && npm run build --workspace=@bcis/api && npm run build --workspace=@bcis/desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=@bcis/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=@bcis/api && npm run typecheck --workspace=@bcis/desktop
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=@bcis/desktop && eslint apps/api/src packages/shared/src --config eslint.config.mjs
scripts.db:seed:dev: npm run build --workspace=@bcis/shared && npm run db:seed:dev --workspace=@bcis/api
scripts.format: prettier --write "apps/api/**/*.{ts,json}" "apps/desktop/src/**/*.{ts,tsx}" "packages/shared/**/*.{ts,json}" apps/desktop/package.json apps/desktop/electron-builder.yml docs/architecture.md apps/desktop/README.md package.json .prettierrc.json README.md
scripts.format:check: prettier --check "apps/api/**/*.{ts,json}" "apps/desktop/src/**/*.{ts,tsx}" "packages/shared/**/*.{ts,json}" apps/desktop/package.json apps/desktop/electron-builder.yml docs/architecture.md apps/desktop/README.md package.json .prettierrc.json README.md
